explainer.title: Every play is worth points.
explainer.text: We judge every snap by how many points it adds to or takes away from the drive. On 3rd-and-8, a conversion adds about +2.4 points; a sack costs about 1.9. Here's what 1st-and-10 is worth depending on where you start.
